title: Connect the existing sealed final artifact return caller
summary: Existing-task counter on 45a0ee0c/01f3043c: (1) retirement now requires a successful complete opted-in roundtrip or successful compensation; (2) final verify and both roundtrip legs get the actual dev-<root|bff> candidate Compose path/component; (3) FE controller is bound to the admitted frontend deploy run head_sha and verified (HEAD, tracked script and relative helpers) before restore-sealed executes; (4) AC5 CLI test now executes the original sender/watchdog/driver/library/validator chain with isolated SSH, Docker, HTTP and an explicit FE command mock. Prior genuine fixes preserved. Not hosted acceptance.

ac1_correct_final_caller_gaps.evidence: Fixed runner compensation validator rejection of final readback (both as restore and restore-final). Added restore-final operation support and validated candidate receipt and FE seal digests in dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py.

ac2_driver_verify_and_restore_final.evidence: Extended deploy_nonprod_vm.sh with --artifact-target <baseline|final>, --artifact-restore-final, explicit candidate compose resolution via resolve_dev_candidate_compose, and candidate argument forwarding. Connected nonprod-deploy.yml coordinate-dev-release to run final verify/seal readback under a pinned per-operation lease and lease wrapper on frontend_release success before accepting the release.

ac3_extend_compensation_evidence.evidence: dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py validates admitted final readback against candidate receipt and candidate-frontend.json seal (deliberately consuming validated frontend structure from typed readbacks or seal files, and strictly verifying all eight identity fields: candidate_id, run_id, attempt, controller_sha, candidate_backend_sha, candidate_frontend_sha, previous_backend_sha, previous_frontend_sha with exact keys), verifies candidate backend SHA, and sets restored_pair to candidate on restore-final while preserving baseline restore.

ac4_supported_invocations_documented.evidence: Documented concrete CLI invocations for final verify and restore-final in docs/deployment/dev-exact-artifact-rollback.md without modifying FE controller or symlinks directly, including credential preflight isolation, opt-in workflow roundtrip, and source integration test boundaries.

ac5_full_test_suite_coverage.evidence: test_full_cli_restore_final_executes_original_bff_chain runs CLI -> original guarded sender -> isolated SSH -> original bootstrap/remote watchdog -> original driver/library bytes (git show of the admitted controller commit) -> external readback validator consuming the driver-generated readback, plus tampered-final-seal and unadmitted-FE-controller negatives. Synthetic boundaries: PATH ssh and python3 shims (fixed path/hostname constants), driver-test Docker/HTTP models, explicit FE command mock. Not hosted evidence.

ac6_scoped_files_only.evidence: Only the 9 scoped files modified and tracked. Non-interactive worker commit and task handoff.

seven_point_counter_resolution.item1_fe_owner_and_delegation_laundering: deploy_nonprod_vm.sh no longer silently converts invalid owner UUIDs to pantheon-dev-deploy or overrides explicit false delegation; test_fe_owner_restore_sealed_rejects_unauthorized_owner and test_fe_owner_restore_sealed_rejects_non_delegated_lease verify fail-closed behavior before any mutations.
seven_point_counter_resolution.item2_current_run_exported_across_ssh: deploy_nonprod_vm.sh exports GITHUB_RUN_ID and GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT across SSH command_prefix without falling back to sealed run ID; test_full_cli_restore_final_connected_positive verifies distinct current run ID with sanitized remote environment.
seven_point_counter_resolution.item3_fe_controller_runner_checkout_bind: compensate_cross_repo_release.sh resolves the admitted FE deploy run head_sha via GitHubClient.get_run and exports PANTHEON_DEV_FE_CONTROLLER_SHA; deploy_nonprod_vm.sh verify_fe_controller_checkout requires checkout HEAD == admitted commit and tracked, unmodified deploy-dev-vm.sh/atomic helpers before executing restore-sealed; restore-final fails closed without it.
seven_point_counter_resolution.item4_candidate_compose_single_path_enfo: Explicit <root>/dev-<root|bff>/docker-compose.yml (component-aware) shared by final verify and both legs, path comes from the configured DEV_DEPLOY_WORKTREE_ROOT only (compensation/workflow prepare have no VM HOME fallback; a missing path is rejected fail-closed); receipt digest still verified; no alias or directory search.
seven_point_counter_resolution.item5_test_boundaries_and_evidence_truth: Documentation and evidence manifest truthfully bound test_full_cli_restore_final_connected_positive as source-level synthetic integration proof, explicitly distinguishing it from real external FE owner execution and hosted deployment acceptance.
seven_point_counter_resolution.item6_normal_roundtrip_workflow_entry: nonprod-deploy.yml adds workflow_dispatch input run_exact_artifact_roundtrip (default false) with roundtrip_baseline_restore and roundtrip_final_return steps after final verify, wired into retirement and compensation outcomes.
seven_point_counter_resolution.item7_viewer_credentials_and_preflight_i: nonprod-deploy.yml plumbs dedicated viewer credentials into final_artifact_verify; deploy_nonprod_vm.sh bypasses preflight checks only when ARTIFACT_VERIFY=true, retaining full runtime credentials preflight on restore operations; verified by test_artifact_restore_retains_runtime_preflight_while_verify_bypasses.
